# Raghav Kanva

> Raghav Kanva is an SEO Consultant helping digital marketing agencies, businesses, founders, and experts reach the right customers through Google and AI search, understand what may be holding them back, and grow their business online.

Raghav Kanva takes a business-first approach to SEO and search strategy.

His work goes beyond looking only at keywords, rankings, or traffic. He first works to understand the business, its customers, what it sells, what it does best, why customers choose it, what customers care about, how people currently find it, and what the business wants more of.

This understanding helps reveal relevant search opportunities and business strengths that may not yet be clear online.

## Main Website

- [Raghav Kanva | SEO Consultant](https://raghavkanva.com/): Official website describing Raghav Kanva's SEO consulting approach, services, audiences, and contact options.

## Core Approach

Raghav Kanva believes that understanding the business makes search opportunities clearer.

The discovery and research process can include understanding:

- who the business wants to reach
- what the business sells
- what the business does best
- why people choose the business
- what customers care about
- how people find the business today
- what the business wants more of

Possible outcomes may include more relevant leads, customers, sales, enquiries, bookings, purchases, or other forms of business growth.

## Business Discovery

When deeper understanding is useful, Raghav can work directly with the business, founder, agency, or relevant team members.

Discovery and working sessions can take place:

- online
- in person when appropriate
- directly with a founder or business owner
- with relevant members of an existing agency or business team

The purpose of these discussions is to understand the real business situation before deciding what search opportunities deserve attention.

This can reveal information that may not be obvious from SEO tools alone, such as:

- products or services the business performs especially well
- the type of customer the business serves best
- reasons existing customers choose the business
- useful knowledge held by founders or team members
- common customer questions and concerns
- areas of expertise that are not clearly represented online
- services or products with strong business value
- differences between the customers the business currently attracts and the customers it actually wants

Raghav then connects useful business strengths and customer needs with what people are searching for online.

## When the Current Approach Is Not Working

Raghav can also help when SEO work is already happening but the expected customers or results are not coming.

This may involve:

- understanding what has already been tried
- reviewing the current approach
- identifying possible problems or missed opportunities
- bringing a fresh point of view
- helping determine what deserves attention next

This is relevant to digital marketing agencies as well as businesses managing their own SEO.

## How Raghav Can Help

### Organic Search

Help the right customers find a business when they search for the products, services, expertise, or information it provides.

### SEO Review and Diagnosis

Review what is currently happening, understand what may be holding results back, and identify areas that deserve attention.

### Business Strengths and Search Opportunities

Identify products, services, experience, expertise, customer needs, or other strengths that may not currently be clear online and connect them with relevant search demand.

### Website and Landing Page Guidance

Help make important website pages easier for visitors to understand so people can quickly understand what the business offers and why it may be a suitable choice.

### Content Strategy

Use real customer needs, business knowledge, expertise, and search demand to guide useful website and content opportunities.

### AI Search

Improve how clearly a business, its products, services, and expertise are represented online so AI-powered search and answer systems can better understand the business.

No guarantee is made that a particular AI system will cite, recommend, rank, or mention a business.

### Paid Advertising

Google Ads and Meta Ads may be considered when paid reach is useful for the specific business situation.

Paid advertising is a supporting capability rather than the primary positioning of the consultancy.

## Who Raghav Works With

### Digital Marketing Agencies

Raghav works with digital marketing agencies in two broad situations.

#### Client SEO

When an agency needs:

- a fresh point of view on a client project
- additional SEO help
- review of an existing approach
- support with selected SEO work
- full SEO support for a suitable client project

#### The Agency's Own SEO

Raghav can also help an agency improve its own online presence so more relevant prospective clients can discover and understand the agency.

### Businesses

Raghav works with businesses that want:

- the right customers to find them
- customers to better understand what they offer
- their strongest products, services, or expertise to be clearer online
- more relevant leads, sales, enquiries, customers, purchases, bookings, or other business outcomes
- to grow their business online

### Founders and Experts

Raghav also works with founders and experts whose knowledge, experience, services, or expertise should be easier for the right audience to discover and understand.

The goal may include creating more relevant opportunities and supporting income growth.

## Collaboration

Raghav remains personally involved in planning and important decisions.

When useful, he can also work with an existing business or agency team.

Collaboration may happen online or in person depending on the situation and what is useful for the project.

This does not imply a permanent full-time or embedded role.

## Working Principle

The goal is to help the right customers find and understand the business, support the business in achieving relevant goals, and create opportunities to grow the business online.

Raghav does not guarantee:

- number-one Google rankings
- specific traffic growth
- specific lead volumes
- sales or revenue
- fixed SEO timelines
- AI citations
- AI recommendations
- mentions in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or other AI systems

Recommendations are based on the business situation, available information, research, data, and professional judgment.
